inputClasses: VRM bytes (git-tracked mtoon_default.vrm when present, else 4 KB synthetic bytes)
trust policy Blob naming trusted Ed25519 signers
invariants: a valid sidecar passes binding, signature and trust separately
a missing sidecar is MISSING_INPUT with exit missingCapability and verdict incomplete
an untrusted signer is UNTRUSTED_SIGNER/gateFailed while binding and signature still pass
a one-bit tamper is BINDING_FAILED with observed/required hashes; re-exported (appended) bytes are a stale-manifest BINDING_FAILED
a forged claim under the old signature is SIGNATURE_INVALID; a trust policy with the wrong sha256 is VALIDATION_FAILED at /trustPolicy/sha256
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
